author: Kristian
comment: We have just returned from our 6th stay at LUX* South Ari Atoll, and once again, it was an absolutely flawless experience. Each visit feels more special than the last, and this year was no exception. The attention to detail, the warmth and professionalism of the staff, and the overall atmosphere on the island continue to be unmatched anywhere else.This year, the special celebrations truly stood out — Halloween, Diwali, and private dining experiences were all meticulously planned and incredibly vibrant, creating some of our most cherished memories yet. As divers, we were again amazed by the stunning marine life we encountered, including manta rays and whale sharks, and the exceptional team at Euro-Divers made every underwater adventure perfect.LUX* South Ari Atoll remains our go-to destination, and we are already looking forward to returning for another unforgettable stay. Whether it’s your first visit or your sixth, this island will leave you enchanted.Read more

author: Cathy J
comment: If you're looking for a truly amazing vacation, I would wholeheartedly recommend the LUX South Ari Atoll. We had never been to the Maldives but we had heard it was beautiful, and because we hadn't had a vacation in over a year, we decided to treat ourselves to the LUX Villa for our 5-night stay there.That was the best decision we've made in a long time. From the moment we arrived at the Male airport and the LUX Lounge there, to the morning we flew back home, we were treated to a seamless, delightful experience that I'm still thinking about. Throughout our stay, everyone displayed a clear love for their work, which meant we felt an exceptional level of service and hospitality. Each interaction felt warm and sincere, making us feel not just welcomed, but genuinely appreciated.The LUX Villa. It's huge – with a private swimming pool, a gorgeous bathroom, glass floor in the living room where you can watch fish swimming below, a bar that's stocked with mixers, fresh mint leaves, etc., outside space for relaxing, reading and meditation - and a stunning view of the Indian ocean all around.  On top of all that they provide a 24-hour butler with the LUX Villa, and our butler, Ahmed, was an absolute gem. He drove us everywhere in the buggy, made all our meal reservations (8 restaurants there in all), let us know about special events and activities we might want to join, made a video of us at the villa with his drone and even put it to music (!),took us on a snorkelling trip where he and another team member pulled us through the water so we could see a giant sea turtle and a whale shark (the biggest fish on the planet). And he even made us special cocktails at our villa bar!There are a number of other complimentary add-ons besides the butler that come with the Villa (a massage for each person, private yoga sessions, sunset cruise, private movie screening (complete with popcorn, ice cream, etc.), laundry service, etc.), but I think our 24-hour butler – the exceptional care we got from such a gentleman as Ahmed, elevated our experience to new heights. This resort is a testament to the art of hospitality, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking an unparalleled luxury getaway…Read more

author: David
comment: After reading many reviews for accommodation on the Maldives we booked 6 nights at the Lux hotel with a Romantic Beach villa to celebrate my 60th Birthday and were not disappointed.From arrival we were greeted by our host and guide Avazbek (Ben) and he provided us will daily information on available restaurants, special events and activities and made all  our bookings, he even spent time to sit with us and chat about our family and places that we have been, which we really enjoyed and appreciated his time with us. The beach villa was perfect as it had its own private pool and a short walk to the beach. The accommodation itself was delightful with everything that we could have needed and was clean and tidy with a well stocked fridge and daily house service. The buffet food was deliciciuos with all variety of food including plentiful choices of world wide cuisines, we chose both the lobster night and Maldavian night (extra cost) which we thoroughly enjoyed. We also tried Allegria the Italian restuarant which was excellent. Daily breakfast at Mixe was super, again with wide choices of options. We would also like to thank all the staff, who were so friendly and extremely helpful, Special thanks to Rauan and Aru in the Mixe restaurant and Jaisham the shuttle bus driver. The young man (sorry forgot his name) who serviced our room was also so helpful and spent time showing us videos of sharks, rays that he had taken.Would definitely return to this wonderful location.Read more

author: JIM
comment: The Resort was fantastic and the staff were excellent. Food was second to none and great variety across all the restaurants.  The facilities and the activities available were great and diverse and one can be as active or inactive as one likes. So it caters for all tastes.Read more

author: Stefanie H
comment: For us, it was our third stay at Lux* South Ari Atoll. After several years and the COVID-19 pandemic, we were somewhat worried that we might not be able to match our previous wonderful experiences. But that wasn’t the case at all. Quite the opposite: everything was even a bit better than we remembered from the last time. Besides the breathtakingly beautiful island itself, the friendliness and dedication of all the staff to make their guests happy and satisfied were simply fantastic.Every wish was somehow made a reality, even when we decided, contrary to our original booking, that we didn’t want to change rooms, which didn’t quite fit with the high occupancy rate. Elena (our contact at reception) somehow made it possible. Gabrielle from the Celebration Desk had already taken care of our requests and wishes expressed by email before our stay, and again, everything we hoped for was arranged. Without even asking, a late checkout and the latest possible departure by seaplane were arranged for us on our departure day, allowing us to enjoy one last great day in the room we had come to love.The service at Lux* is truly unmatched. Whether interacting with the friendly shuttle drivers like Mofizul, who quickly arranged a small personal photo session at sunset, or Shawkat, who, after almost 19 years on the same island, knows every palm tree and patiently answers every question with interesting stories, or Jaisham and the many other kind and helpful drivers whose names we unfortunately don’t know—all of them enriched every journey on the island and would drop you off right at your own bungalow if you wished.In the restaurants and bars, the staff’s efforts to fulfill every guest’s wishes were incredible: at the Senses Bar, the team frequently made us drinks that weren’t even on the menu because we simply enjoyed them. Alauddin and Ravi at the East Bar treated us to their own delicious cocktail creations, as did Arun at the Veli Bar. Sometimes the attention could be a bit much; for example, when we later learned a “special table” had been prepared for us the previous evening, but we hadn’t known about it and chose a different restaurant, or when you’re encouraged multiple times a day to spend the afternoon/evening at a particular place.We’d especially like to mention A.J. and Tobey, whom we greatly appreciated during our stay and who delighted us every evening with their duets for an hour at the East Bar (unfortunately, they were somewhat in high demand at the Allegria in the evenings, so we rarely got to hear them later on).There are so many small things worth mentioning: the cookies you could always pick up at Café Lux, the consistently wonderful food—whether at the buffets, à la carte, at Café Lux, or the fantastic Ici—the range of vegetarian and vegan options, the carefully designed theme nights, the commitment to sustainability, coral reef protection and restoration, as well as the incredibly attentive housekeeping and daily hidden bottles containing little surprises… It’s hard to know where to stop.The minor criticisms we could even think of (such as the somewhat worn condition of some rental bikes) are so negligible compared to all the fantastic aspects that we don’t even find them worth mentioning any further.In any case, this certainly wasn’t our last visit to Lux* South Ari Atoll, and we very much hope the next one will be soon.Read more

author: keelsg
comment: Just returned from a 12 night stay at the lux, we stopped in a beach villa and a water villa and had the most amazing time.  Kayla greeted us and kept in touch with us daily, anything we wanted to do we just sent Kayla a text  and she organised this, from restaurant bookings to trips, she was amazing, The resort is so relaxing and chilled it’s the perfect romantic get awayWhat really makes the credit is the staff, every single staff member who we met greeted us warmly and nothing was too much trouble.  It seems unfair to mention names as they were all amazing, however rauan greeted us every breakfast at the mixe and ensured she gave my husband his favourite table, also shakat made the buggy journeys a highlight of our dayWill definitely return, had the best holiday everyRead more

author: Kunal P
comment: Wow wow wow. What a fabulous hotel. This stay had surpassed all of our expectations. What an incredible resort. We travellled as a family of three and spent a few nights in the romantic pool villa and then the next few nights in the overwater pool villas. The service and attention to detail was incredible. The people on this island work tirelessly to make our holiday enjoyable with majority not seeing their own family for months. It must be so hard but all of them always had a smile on their faces. A special shoutout to Basil who my daughter had a special bond with. Arun from the ice cream parlour- my daughter used to love seeing him and talking to him. The manager of mixe Daminder who shared a little story about his family and looked after my daughter creating a special fruit platter every morning. On out last day we spent the afternoon with Shivuzee making boats at the arts and crafts centre. What a wonderful and creative man he is. Helped my daughter make boats and such a friendly human being!The food was insane- we were all inclusive and loved the food- not budget in anyway but top class in all areas.This hotel should be 6*! We loved every moment and the staff all make you feel so special. We’d be back as soon as we can. Thank you for giving us the best holiday ever and looking after us in such a magical way.Read more

author: Carolina S
comment: Since I was a little girl, I dreamed of waking up on my 40th birthday in a villa in the Maldives. Lux South Ari Atoll turned that dream into reality in a way I never could have imagined. When something goes beyond your expectations, it truly becomes part of the soundtrack of your life.The level of detail here is outstanding – from the beautifully designed facilities to the small touches like the unique “Lux” footprint on the flip-flops. This hotel doesn’t just leave a mark on the sand but on the hearts of everyone who visits.While the location is paradise, what truly makes this place unforgettable is the incredible staff. Special shoutout to Shawkat, who exemplified warmth and professionalism; Chef Allan, for an exceptional live dining experience; and our concierge Kayla, who went above and beyond each day to make everything feel effortless. Gen from the dive center brought us closer to the ocean’s wonders with genuine empathy and enthusiasm.The food is exceptional, and the thoughtful attempts by the staff to connect with us in Spanish added an extra touch of warmth. These small gestures made us feel even more at home in paradise.Thank you to the team who made this all possible. And a fair warning: we’re already planning our return!With heartfelt gratitude,Niko and CarolinaRead more

author: John S
comment: It is truly amazing! I came for the Forbes Audit and the Seaplane experience was the best, Pilot Mr. Abu Bakuru Al- Siddiq was top 👌 he flew the Seaplane very smooth. It was a very rainy days as well but the Hotel is 5 star, I totally recommend this hotel.Read more

author: 534rachel
comment: This was our third holiday at Lux and I can honestly say it gets better every time!  We chose Lux to havs a very special family holiday for my 50th Birthday and it did not disappoint! Never have I had so many birthday cakes in one day, wiith the staff singing happy birthday to me at every opportunity 😂The service, food and facilities are outstanding. It is a snorkelling paradise and I highly recommend the dolphin sunrise cruise. The sunset cruise was also lovely and Nilhaan was an excellent and informative host.We prefer to stay in the water villas but all of the rooms are lovely and they have something to suit everyone. The new lagoon rooms with pools look lovely.Our favourite beach restaurant is Senses, it is the best Indian food I have ever had and Subhunni and Sentil are master chefs!East Market is a fabulous over water dining experience with the best buffet selection I have ever experienced. Mr Pong provided us with amazing Thai dishes that had us smiling and full each night.  Glenda was also lovely, providing an excellent service.For pre dinner drinks the very best place to go is East Bar where the lovely Mano, Ravi and Allaudin will concoct the most delicious cocktails for you and provide the very best service. Mixe is our choice for breakfast most mornings as it is closer to our water villa and Rimaah always had a friendly welcome for us each day. East Market is also lovely for breakfast with stunning views over the lagoon.For our days lounging on the beach we prefer Senses beach as it is a little quieter there and very close to our water villa. We were also very well looked after at all times by Shahumeen, Moosa, Pintu and Mamun ❤️ The check in/check out is always seamless with a very quick transfer time from the lux lounge at the airport to the resort by seaplane..  Yaameen in the airport on departure is always so lovely and helpful, a real asset to the resort!The buggy service at the resort is regular enough that you arent waiting too long and of course I have to say a big thank you to the star of the resort, Shawcat,  the best buggy driver in the Maldives 😁  Our daughter insists Lux is the only Maldive island she will ever return to as nowhere else has Shawcat! She will happiliy spend hours driving up and down the island with him listening to his interesting stories.Thank you to everyone at Lux and we cannot wait to come back and see you all in February ❤️Read more

author: Susan V
comment: We had a great time. The hotel managed to never feel overcrowded and was very spacious and intriguingly laid out. It offered a variety of activities, ensuring that a family with children, where the parents enjoy diving, could all find something to their liking. The grounds were beautifully designed..The diving was great, food was delicious, kids had a splendid time. Trip included whale sharks and mantas spotting  - a highlight for everyoneRead more

author: Rick S
comment: The LUX South Ari Atol is fantastic! This was our second stay there and we had an even better time than the first (if possible)!   The hospitality team is amazing — we were remembered by many team members from our visit a yesr ago!   We really like the healthy, green focus on cuisine.  Our family eats a completely plant based diet and there were plenty of creative, tasty food options; and the chefs took great initiative in suggesting and creating special dishes for us.    The island is beautiful and relaxing, the facilities, including spa, are top notch, and we felt pampered thru our whole experience from being greeted at Male airport to LUX team members assistance checking us back in at the Male airline counter at the end of our trip.   I highly recommend this hotel… the whole experience is fantastic.Read more

author: Maj M
comment: The Lux resort was the best resort we have ever been to. Everything from the staff including Salwa, who was our main host, to the shuttle drivers like Shawkut, to the excursion team with Aank and his team, everything was a pure dream. We have always wanted to go to the Maldives and we are so happy to have stayed at Lux. The fact that there are so many activities and daily excursions makes it so you never miss anything. My four year old son had the time of his life snorkeling in the ocean with turtles and tropical fish. The whole staff was incredibly accommodating to allow us to bring him along and they were so nice and catering to him. I felt like they were his uncles, the way they went out of their way to converse with him. So thoughtful! We initially stayed at the over water bungalow and it was beautiful. We then switched it up to the beach bungalow and that was perfect for our family. My son and I would wake up at 5 and walk the beach, which was literally outside our door. There were baby sharks in the water right in front of our bungalow, the coolest thing ever! I am so glad to have done the research and select Lux as the resort for our stay. We will definitely be coming back and hope to see the wonderful friends we made again. Thank you for the time of our life and the wonderful memories!Read more

author: Jami T
comment: We had a wonderful and super relaxing autumn holiday at the LUX. The kindness and spontaneous service attitude by the staff was heart-warming. We all including our boys felt ourselves welcomed at the beautiful island. Special thanks to our host Salwa, Mr. and Mrs. Rogers and the staff at the diving center. Keep up the good work, we'll definitely come back some day - maybe even next autumn! With best regards, Tammi family, Helsinki FinlandRead more

author: Jane A
comment: Fantastic holiday. We stayed in a beach villa for 12 nights in early October to celebrate our 25th wedding anniversary. It was our third trip to the Maldives and our expectations were high and happy to say Lux delivered consistently. A beautiful resort, very well maintained and serviced, surrounded by gorgeous water. The staff were fantastic in each and every section of the hotel with whatever service you needed. A fabulous villa. We started each day at East Market for breakfast surrounded by that amazing turquoise water.  We were B&B and tried all the restaurants except Japanese.  All were good with Beach Rouge our favourite for dinner.  We stayed on the Sunrise side (lagoon side). It is more sheltered from the heavy winds which unfortunately were pretty bad in our first week having arrived in a bad weather period.  My only negative comment is the location of the solar panels over near the Senses pool.  I recognise their importance but they did hinder the view from that pool which only has loungers on one side.  Anyway, other then that very happy stay. Thank you for all the lovely things you did for our 25th - very appreciated.  All of the staff deserve recognition but sorry, I can only remember some names - Amzad - your breakfast noodles were amazing.  Elena - thank you for looking after us so well. Nita - a fabulous massage. Pulkit at Beach Rouge - you are so dedicated to excellent service.  Housekeeping - the magic duo including Mohamed Ibrahim - wow wow wow ! What you did decorating our room for our 25th anniversary made me speechless and that's something rare - thank you very much!  We would not hesitate to return.Read more

author: Marie W
comment: It was a very nice hotel, good restaurants, very service minded staff, everyone from cleaner, restaurant staff, buggy drivers, beach staff, and our very own host Bek, who supported us with restaurant bookings and excursions were all super helpful.Read more

author: Eva123
comment: A fantastic second trip to Lux, Maldives. We had the same Villa as our last stay ( beach pool villa) which had a great position on the beach. The hospitality, food and general atmosphere was better than we had remembered. Thank you to all the team who look after us, including Bek who looked after us during our week at the resort! Hope to be lucky enough to return soonRead more

author: dfl0wers
comment: This is a 4th lucky visit to the Maldives, and LUX offered a truly magical holiday in paradise.  Warm, welcoming, attentive team ~ who are all genuinely focused on delivering the best customer experience. Restaurant variety is excellent, a brilliant watersports team, and a special mention to Shawkat who certainly belongs in hospitality.Read more

author: Charlotte
comment: We have spent an amazing week at this wonderful resort ! This is one of the finest hotels in the world and you can see why it gets this honour. We travel very regularly and this is the most special place we have stayed. Ben was our host and nothing was too much trouble. We were a family of four and we stayed in the beach villas. The standard of accommodation was outstanding with our own part of the beach and views on the lagoon. We went to the spa and the experience was magical. The best massage we have ever had. The food in the eight restaurants is universally excellent and each place brings something different. Our daughter has a severe peanut allergy and the head chef in each location was brilliant at helping us ensure what she ate was safe and delicious. We did many water sports during our time here and they were great with very knowledgable staff and fantastic wildlife. Each and every member of staff here is excellent at what they do and always with a wonderful smile. Can’t recommend the hotel enough. Thank you for a truly wonderful stay !!!Read more

author: aliciagutierrez1
comment: Thank you LUX for receiving us and making our stay at the Maldives so outstanding in every way. LUX South Ari Atoll is a resort that is full of well-thought details and surprises, amazing food, breathtaking views and beautiful people. Special thanks to Bhupendra for always receiving us at the ice cream place with the biggest smile, spoiling us with lots of ice cream and for giving us the best recommendations!! (note: the speculoos, vanilla and vegan chocolate ice cream are a must try!) To Giada for being such a special host / concierge, for her attentiveness with us, her amazing spanish and for letting us know about all the activities going on at the hotel. To Roshika (from Beach Rouge Restaurant), for doing such a professional job and being so kind and attentive to us. To Juman from Umami (outstanding japanese restaurant, by the way!), for being on top of the game, always going one step ahead of what we required and for making our dinner experience at Umami so memorable. To Shawkat for spreading his positive energy all around the resort and sharing with us great conversations on the boogie rides! P.S. The signature massage with coconut oil is a must-try! Thank you very much to all the LUX Team for such an outstanding experience.Read more

comment: Good place for family escape however surrounding our villa there were families staying hence it was noisy most of time...Resort is good and location is also goos. However lacked in communication What were my inclusions were not informed clearltRead more

author: Altos C
comment: This hotel is amazing!!! The staff are so friendly and are amazing at their jobs! Service varied from place to place but completely understandable as not all of their bars have kitchens. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and made the most of it by doing many of the activities they had to offer. The room service was great and I loved how they gave us towels in shapes of different animals! All staff are friendly and they greet you almost all of the time! On arrival we were immediately welcomed into lux  with smiles and waves. We were toured around the island also! Special shut out to Vijay and Shifaz and the Veli pool bar! We enjoyed the scuba diving trip and water sports! Some reason strangely, they didn’t give me a life vest when I asked for one…? But in overall we had a absolutely fantastic experience!Read more

author: AnnonymousGlasgow
comment: This is a lovely island with lots to do. Their food was excellent with lots of choice. The all-inclusive package was really generous and the options for both food and drink were really broad. We went with 2 teenagers who loved it. The local sea life is really amazing and shark watch was a highlight every night.Read more

author: kcache
comment: The island is truly paradise, with its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and lush tropical surroundings that make it feel like a dream come true.The staff went above and beyond to ensure every detail of my  stay was perfect. My villa was luxurious and well-appointed, offering stunning ocean views and the utmost privacy which made it the perfect retreat. The dining options were exceptional. Every meal was a culinary delight.The restaurants and bars had a fantastic ambiance special the Beach Rouge was WOW.The staff are amazing from Sameer the housekeeping manager to Dami the Food and beverage manager to Dida , Huzam  waiters at  the Beache Rouge  And the team at Veli bar.Thank you for your warm hospitality .Will be back soon!DorothyRead more

author: claire
comment: Fabulous resort with good choice of restaurants and activities. It is large compared to the other Maldivian resorts we have stayed in. I loved that there was a ‘lagoon side’ which was calmer in the windy days. It also has a sand bar that is very pretty. Impeccable service - the staff are just lovely and everything feels luxurious without feel pretentious. Spa is lovely and you can relax there without having a treatment. The weather was not great for us but we still had a nice time. Would love to back and hopefully get better weather. We stayed in a lagoon pavilion which felt very secluded, quiet and private. Two heron and several fruit bats were hanging out in our area which was lovely. The all inclusive package was brilliant.Read more

author: Robert P
comment: Another superbly well run and beautifully presented Lux resort, our second stay with the Lux brand.  The over-whelming impression is of the care, attentiveness, efficiency and friendliness of the staff.  From the resort manager stopping to give us a lift in his buggy to the garden staff always giving friendly greetings, all were great.  Special mention to (please forgive spellings) Showkat (aka "Shortcut") the brilliantly welcoming shuttle driver who entertained adults and children alike, Reemha (in Mixe who greeted us by name every day), Nissanka (in East Market, who was travelling off duty on our airport transfer but still looked after us and was always welcoming and friendly).  We could have named many more.  The hotel facilities were of course excellent, with a beautiful room (Water Villa) and the resort all maintained to a standard we now expect of Lux, caring for the environment without compromising guest experience.  Thank you to all at Lux South Ari Atoll.Read more

author: Hannah C
comment: We had the most amazing holiday and were blown away by the island, the hotel and the team who work here. The holiday couldn’t have been better with there being loads of things to do plus the most amazing beaches and rooms, we couldn’t have asked for more! Bek was incredibly helpful, Ahmed (who looked after 313) was beyond amazing and so lovely and people who work at east market and bar and mixxe (along with all other restaurants) were fantastic. The coffee team are also excellent.Read more

author: Balakopalan S
comment: Lux is an excellent beach resort. The staff are very friendly. Variety of food choices available in all 6 restaurants. The sea views villa with all the amenities made our stay more wonderful. We enjoyed every minute of our stay. It's a nice place to spend your vacation.Read more

author: AUSA_Abroad
comment: I have never been more relaxed than I was during my 8 days at Lux! From the second we landed in Male and the lovely Lux team were waiting to take us to the luxurious sea-plane waiting lounge, to the second our sea-plane landed at the footsteps of the Lux pier we were treated like royalty. Our personal butler, Ahmed, made the holiday special for each and every one of us. Travelling as a family of four with a teenager and tween can sometimes be tricky to find a place that caters to everyone, but Lux (and Ahmed) certainly did. We sprung for the Lux Resort which was a total luxury but worth every penny. The food was excellent and fresh and a great variety, the gym was perfect and an added bonus was the determination of the Lux crew to ensure we saw a whale shark on our whale shark excursion.I cannot recommend this place enough and look forward to going back!Read more

author: RD C
comment: I can not speak highly enough of this resort. Every single member of the team were kind, friendly and helpful. Nothing is too much for any of them. I have never been to a resort where genuine customer care is foremost in every action.The food is excellent across the board, but my favourite was Senses, the staff their went above and beyond to make my meal experience top notch. One of the waiters made a mural of a whale shark and a note out of coffee beans on my last night. A touch of class to make you feel special.My concierge, Rachael, made contact daily and ensured that I was book into the restaurant of my choice each night, as well as excursions.I had a water villa and the villa was cleaned twice a day, the mini bar topped up daily. I am ashamed to say that i did not take the name of person cleaning my room, but he was kind and considerate and so lovely for the 9 days, so thank you to him.The resort has a buggy shuttle service and the drivers are fantastic and friendly. One in particular called Mofizul was so helpful and made me feel so welcome, we chatted daily and he always made me feel happy.I spent a lot of time in the spa, I took advantage of the 5 day discount system they have, each treatment was top class, most of them were carried out by the same therapist, Sujani, she is exceptional, I came away totally relaxed and very much looking forward to my next treatment. Thu and Jojo in the spa received me most days with the biggest smiles and the kindest natures, Jojo gave me a hair treatment on my last full day where he analysed my scalp and hair type, it was fanscinating and my hair after 9 days of sun and lots of wind was beautiful afterwards.My best holiday yet, I came to relax and recover after a very turbulent time in my life, but this reosrt exceeded my expectations.Thank you to all the staff, especially the ones that i had the pleasure of getting to know, for everything you did for me.Read more

author: Happiness61585882559
comment: Lux South Ari Atoll was an absolutely amazing experience! All the staff were super friendly and really went out their way to make your holiday experience unforgettable. We stayed in an overwater and beach villa, which were both great. Food options were great and loved that they had options for all dietary requirements. They even have their own homemade ice cream, which was super delicious. A special thank you to Shawkat, Salwa and the amazing water sports team!Read more

author: Brit C
comment: My husband and I spent our honeymoon at Lux, and it was truly the most incredible experience. The resort itself was exceptional - beautiful, clean, peaceful, and top tier amenities. We spent a morning at the spa, and I would recommend that everybody makes the time to do so, even if just to explore the complimentary amenities. The food was some of the best we’ve had at any resort, each restaurant was unique in its food and drinks, and we didn’t get tired of anything. We originally were not going to eat at Allegria due to it being outside of the All Inclusive Package (and being from New York, we eat a lot of Italian). We decided to book a reservation while here, and oh my god are we glad we did!!! By far, this was the best restaurant we ate at (and we ate at every one). Do not miss this if you come!!! Unfortunately, we were here during a rather rainy and windy week, so we didn’t get to partake in the Whale Shark Discovery experience as we had planned. Even still, there was not a single moment here that felt lackluster.All of that said, what really made our experience so great was the people!!! The staff here are some of the kindest, most welcoming, and friendliest people you will ever encounter. Every day we were greeted by name at breakfast, lunch, and dinner. We got to know some of the staff and learned about their families and hometowns. Every person we passed offered a smile and a hello, and so many people stopped to ask about our experience and see if there was anything we needed to make our stay better. I have to shout out Bek, our concierge/attendant, who messaged us on WhatsApp everyday to let us know about activities, experiences, and restaurant openings. He answered every one of our questions, and really made us feel comfortable and settled!!! Glenda at East Market/Umami, and Alouddin at East Bar were also so wonderful and really made us feel at home!Overall, this was the best trip we could have hoped for, and we hope we get to come back in the future!!!Read more

author: Mohantha D
comment: As expected this was a gorgeous holiday. Lovely location, brilliant service and delicious food.Tried all the restaurants and bars.Great service from the Vali bar team. And our son loved the kids club team. Great memories Special shout out to bek and the reception team.Read more

author: Nadia H
comment: This was our 2nd time back to Lux and our first time with our son and it didn’t fail to impress. Lux is an experience and one you will never forget, our personalised service from Bek was incredible anything we required he went above and beyond to cater for our needs from bookings, to questions to keeping our son happy 😃  The restaurant food quality and service is 5 * and the activities arranged around the island for couples or families make the experience extra memorable. The romantic pool room was so beautiful - perfect for our family.  The spa is the most beautiful setting and the lux products are so wonderful  - we had to take some home. We can’t not mention our housekeeper Mode who surprised us with a flower bath and special arrangements on the bed - our son particularly liked the monkey and teddy bear made on his bed. I literally can not say one bad thing about lux resort and team and south ari atoll - we came for our honeymoon and this experience was even better than we could imagine. author: Lexington
comment: First and foremost let us start by saying the staff at LUX is what really makes this place magical. To say they go the extra mile does not even begin to explore the depth of their dedication to your perfect vacation. CONNECTION/COLLECTION: Thanks to great coordination by our Travel Specialists at DSK Travel, the transfer from Adaaren Hudhuranfusi to LUX South Ari Atoll was seamless. We never felt rushed, we were always in direct contact with expert staff who ensured we arrived back at the airport from Hudhuranfushi and were guided directly to LUX staff who took over. We never touched our bags between leaving our room in the morning and arriving at our villa at LUX. We had a brief 45 min. stay at the LUX Lounge at the seaplane terminal which was very nice, with all forms of coffee, snacks and comfortable seating/laying options. From there to the seaplane for the 25 minute trip to South Ari Atoll. The plane was full, but in no way uncomfortable for the brief flight.    RECEPTION/CHECK-IN: Upon tying up to the LUX dock we wee greeted by 4-6 staff and the General Manager, John. It was only then we realized we were the only LUX guests on he flight, the rest flying on to Vilamendhoo.  We were immediately greeted ushered into the lovely open air reception area to meet Jovi, our “personal” guest experience host, who handed us the most amazing welcome drinks (sans alcohol). If you have the choice, the Basil, Fennel and Orange was one of the best drinks ever! With that, our room was ready and Jovi showed us the way across the walkway to our overwater villa. Jovi was always just a “text” away via What’s App and consistently ensured we were able to eat where we wanted, take excursions, etc., a true asset to the guest experience.   VILLA: We stayed in Romantic Overwater Pool Villa #139. This is situated at the “T” in the main walkway over the lagoon, with many rooms to the left, and a few to the right. This, despite being at the main walkway point for all these villas, was nearly perfect. It was as short a walk as you can have back to the island or to the East Market restaurant, bar and Umami. At no time did this result in noise or other issues, so a “quick” trip back to the room was just a little simpler. The inside of the room was bright, modern, yet had a true ocean/beach feel. They provide the standard UK electrical sockets, but USB ports were at nearly every important location, so we never needed our UK adapters. The view straight out from the bed was over the “infinity pool” and out over the ocean. The television had numerous options for utilizing Netflix, Amazon Prime as well as some worldwide news, sports and movie channels. Our ocean facing deck featured the mention pool that was larger than we anticipated, perfect for lounging and deep enough to keep comfortably submerged. It was particularly nice to sit in the pool with a drink and watch the fish and black tip shark swim past. We actually saw an eagle ray, a stingray and two sharks in the first few minutes of our stay from our deck. Also the deck included two loungers, a hanging “nest” love seat, two chairs, a small table, and stairs into the ocean. Three points that could use improvement: the sliding door to the deck needed adjustment or grease, but was particularly loud to open, thus sneaking out to capture the sunrise without waking each other was not an option. The second slight miss, was the overhead projector screen that allows a large screen view experience seemed to cause issue with the sound bar, making the audio sound off and resulted in us just watching the perfectly large enough TV screen. And the last “complaint” was that the orientation of the room and deck made viewing the sunrise directly impractical, unless you stood in the water at the base of the stairs into the ocean. None of these in anyway would prevent us from readily selecting this room again, but given the slight zig-zag of the villas some may be better than others for seeing the sunrise…  Our villa was serviced by Malik, who treated us to a towel crab and a whale shark, and we never wanted for any towels, drinks, etc. And of course, Aleef, the water villa housekeeping “captain” couldn’t be more helpful, always checking to ensure we were not wanting for anything and scoring us some of the room scent spray that was no longer available in the boutique. Again, the staff at LUX just can’t do enough and were all warm and personable.  FOOD & BEVERAGE:  Incredible. We didn’t have a single thing we didn’t enjoy. The buffet at East Market is amazing, with 6+ live stations at both breakfast and dinner. The number of entrees and cuisine types ensures there’s little chance you won’t find something you’ll love. The all the chefs are very helpful in explaining the dishes and helping you choose combinations for wok stirfrys, noodle soups, pasta dishes, you name it. We has one meal at Umami, which we were treated to a decorated tables and personal skilled service by Juman, and with chef Alan coming out to check on us. The wagyu skewers and Toothfish were outstanding! But not one thing was less than excellent. Senses for a great Indian meal, and Allegria for fine Italian. We frequented Beach Rouge more for lunch than any other venue, though we tried every place and never were disappointed. The food is of very good quality everywhere. But of course the magic is the staff. Roshika at Beach Rouge was a perfect host, we watched in amazement as she very patiently assisted a very impatient couple with which the language barrier was difficult, her warm smile never disappeared despite the couples impatience. Glenda at East Market always greeted us by name and asked about our previous meals, and where we were going that evening, with a few perfect suggestions. Rimaah also always greeted us by name and we enjoyed conversing with her, a truly warm person who we quickly came to look for at MIXE or East Market. FACILITIES: Everything is well kept, clean, and inviting. Beaches and walkways were constantly raked and cleared of debris, leading to pristine lengths of white sand and beautiful clear water. The buildings are generally a bit modern with a chic vibe, the music in most venues reminded us of a trendy hotel lobby, with only the Lagoon bar having a different “reggae” feel. The various venue bathrooms are a fun distraction, each being very well maintained, immaculate, featuring cloth hand-towels, and each decorated differently. The East Market bathroom was of particular note, with its upbeat music, flashy photography on the walls and even a photobooth in the common wash area. Beach Rouge also has a more playful bathroom worth visiting. A few other standouts: Shawkat the best buggy driver constantly had us laughing and is truly a guest experience booster. And we really enjoyed spending time at Beach Rouge in the afternoons, soaking up the sun and enjoying great service from Masud and Bhupendra (who we were so glad to be able to connect with minutes before we had to depart). LUX Me Spa: Wow, what to say? Fantastic services, free use of the sauna, steam room and plunge pool, and the view from the relaxation deck alone is worth the visit. The staff here was excellent. LEAVING PARADISE: We opted for a late check-out given our late evening flight and were able to utilize our villa (and the AI) until 1510 when we had to ensure the bags were ready for pick-up. Checking out was simple and we chose to use the LUX lounge at the seaplane port as our layover destination before checking in for our international flights home. Again, a seamless seaplane flight out at 16:10 hrs, then relaxing stay in the lounge until 20:00 when we were escorted through to the airport, where another employee helped us navigate past the initial security line and through a “short-cut and directly to the Emirates check-in. Truly, not once were we lost, confused, or concerned with where or when we needed to be somewhere. Just fantastic service, start to finish. SUMMARY: The LUX staff delivers stellar service, which was the real magic in making this such a fantastic vacation. Everything from the care and maintenance of the facilities, the beauty of the beaches and water and quality of the food is top-notch. This truly is a 5 Star resort with no pretentiousness.One last note on the staff: I lost my cellphone one day and despite all the looking and retracing steps it was gone. But staff was amazing trying to help, and shortly into the ordeal, Roshan from security met with us and started helping as well. We decided not to waste another minute on this inconvenience and went to lunch, after which I discovered my Tile tracker app could also show where my phone last pinged. Long story short it was at the beach where we were snorkeling. After telling Roshan I probably forgot to take it out of my trunks and its in the ocean, he took off to look for it. We changed and went o see if was too be found and there was Roshan looking on shore while another security employee, Diwash, was snorkeling along the beach area! Incredulous at their dedication, we joined in searching the waters off the beach, and when I met up with Diwash he was in full uniform! Pants, polo, and a scuba mask. I tried to convince him it wasn’t worth finding in the ocean, but he just smiled and went right back to looking. 45 minutes later, success! Diwash found my Samsung S23 and it’s still working today! My deepest appreciation to Roshan and Diwash who went the extra mile and beyond. It isn’t often we see firsthand how the security team works to ensure everyone’s stay is perfect, but they truly displayed the LUX spirit of “nothing is too much for their guests”. And finally, our thanks to DSK Travel for helping us make this selection, lifetime memories were made.Read more

comment: We just returned from an absolutely spectacular 5-night stay at Lux South Ari Atoll, where we celebrated our 5th wedding anniversary. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with impeccable hospitality that set the tone for the entire experience.A special thanks goes to our favorite driver, Shawcut, who always made us feel at home, ensuring our transfers were comfortable and enjoyable. Another highlight was Abdulla Dhaai, our snorkeling guide. He gave us an unforgettable experience by taking us to see whale sharks and turtles, a moment that will forever remain in our memories. We also can’t forget our stay manager, Avaz Bek, who took care of every detail of our trip with incredible attention, making sure each day was special.Lux South Ari Atoll is paradise on earth. The white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and peaceful environment create the perfect setting for such a special celebration. Every meal was a delight, with an impressive variety and incredible quality. We was 6 days of pure magic, and we can’t wait to return to a Lux branch!Read more
